stops.name: Reichenbach Falls Funicular
stops.quote: Take the nostalgic Reichenbach Falls cable car to the 120-meter-high waterfall near Meiringen and walk in the footsteps of Sherlock Holmes.
stops.english: Take the nostalgic Reichenbach Falls cable car to the 120-meter-high waterfall near Meiringen and walk in the footsteps of Sherlock Holmes.

stops.name: Sherlock Holmes Museum
stops.quote: The Sherlock Holmes Museum is one of the highlights, besides the bronze statue and the roaring Reichenbach Falls with the fateful battle site.
stops.english: The Sherlock Holmes Museum is one of the highlights, besides the bronze statue and the roaring Reichenbach Falls with the fateful battle site.

stops.name: Aare Gorge
stops.quote: Discover Meiringen-Hasliberg in the Bernese Oberland: The Aare Gorge, Reichenbach Falls, family-friendly ski area and magnificent hiking trails await you.
stops.english: Discover Meiringen-Hasliberg in the Bernese Oberland: The Aare Gorge, Reichenbach Falls, family-friendly ski area and magnificent hiking trails await you.

stops.name: Reichenbachtal
stops.quote: Easy, long ascent through Reichenbachtal up to Grosse Scheidegg at the foot of the mighty Wetterhorn cliffs.
stops.english: Easy, long ascent through Reichenbachtal up to Grosse Scheidegg at the foot of the mighty Wetterhorn cliffs.

stops.name: Rosenlaui Hotel
stops.quote: Hike past the nostalgic Rosenlaui Hotel and glacier gorge, enchanted by the Wetterhorn.
stops.english: Hike past the nostalgic Rosenlaui Hotel and glacier gorge, enchanted by the Wetterhorn.

stops.name: Gasthaus Zwirgi
stops.quote: Zwirgi Inn Gateway to the mystical, rustic Reichenbach valley.
stops.english: Zwirgi Inn Gateway to the mystical, rustic Reichenbach valley.

stops.name: Rosenlauischlucht (gorge)
stops.quote: Along the Lütschine up to Grindelwald, the glacier village at the foot of the majestic Eiger, Mönch & Jungfrau peaks, on over Grosse Scheidegg, past Rosenlauischlucht (gorge) and the Reichenbach Falls, where Sherlock Holmes fell to his death, to Meiringen.
stops.english: Along the Lütschine up to Grindelwald, the glacier village at the foot of the majestic Eiger, Mönch & Jungfrau peaks, on over Grosse Scheidegg, past Rosenlauischlucht (gorge) and the Reichenbach Falls, where Sherlock Holmes fell to his death, to Meiringen.
